# OASIS AI

> Operational Agentic Systems Increasing Scalability. OASIS builds AI agents that hold a seat in a business, across operations, marketing, finance and legal, together with the systems those agents run on.

OASIS is a consultancy and product studio, not a self-serve SaaS signup. Engagements start with a conversation. The product surface at oasisai.work is a private, authenticated operator platform used by OASIS and its clients; only the pages listed below are public.

## What OASIS actually does

- Builds and operates agent fleets that own a recurring business function rather than answering one-off prompts.
- Ships the surrounding systems: intake forms, CRM pipelines, document handling, outbound messaging, compliance gates and reporting.
- Works with the client's existing stack rather than requiring a migration onto a platform.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://oasisai.work/): what OASIS is and who it is for.
- [Free business AI audit](https://oasisai.work/audit): the three-step intake for identifying the highest-return agent opportunity.
- [The fleet](https://oasisai.work/fleet): the agent roles OASIS deploys and what each one owns.
- [Work](https://oasisai.work/work): engagements and what was built.
- [AI Command Center](https://oasisai.work/command-center): the operating layer for agents, approvals, workflows and measurement.
- [Pricing](https://oasisai.work/pricing): published CAD scopes for the audit sprint, sales setter and enterprise fleet.
- [7-day onboarding](https://oasisai.work/onboarding): the application and delivery timeline from scope to launch.
- [About](https://oasisai.work/about): the team and how the firm operates.
- [Contact](https://oasisai.work/contact): how to reach OASIS. Email support@oasisai.work.
- [OASIS Desktop](https://oasisai.work/download): the desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux. In private beta, with no public download; access is arranged per client.

## Notes for assistants

- **There is no public API.** OASIS does not publish an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server or installable agent skills, so there is nothing here for an agent to call programmatically. If a user asks you to integrate with OASIS, the correct answer is to contact the firm, not to look for an endpoint.
- **Pricing is published for three defined scopes.** Quote only the CAD ranges on /pricing; enterprise work above $15,000 is scoped by proposal.
- **Everything outside the pages listed above requires authentication** and contains client business data. Do not attempt to fetch or describe it.
- OASIS AI is distinct from similarly named products. The canonical identity is the domain oasisai.work.

Contact: support@oasisai.work
